name: @magpie-community/opencode-antigravity-bridge
description: Connect to Antigravity via the official agy CLI to help reduce account risk from client impersonation. Lean prompts and session reuse cut redundant context and token usage. Multiple Google accounts supported via per-account agy profiles (`<account>/<model>` in the picker).

scripts.test: node --test test-step-usage.mjs test-usage.mjs test-compat.mjs test-platform.mjs test-prompt-guard.mjs test-tool-schema.mjs test-upstream-error.mjs test-thought-filter.mjs test-mcp-server.mjs test-accounts-import.mjs test-accounts-login.mjs test-wsl.mjs test-context-unlock.mjs && node test-smoke.mjs

summary.en: Connect to Antigravity via the official agy CLI to help reduce account risk from client impersonation. Lean prompts and session reuse cut redundant context and token usage. Multiple Google accounts via per-account agy profiles: pick `<account>/<model>` in the model picker.
summary.zh: 通过官方 agy CLI 接入 Antigravity，旨在降低模拟客户端带来的封号风险；精简提示词、复用会话，减少重复上下文与 Token 消耗。支持多账号：每个账号独立 agy 配置目录，在模型选择器里选 `<账号>/<模型>` 即可切换。
